name: Opinionated settings for Claude Code
description: Adds opinionated settings for Claude Code.

weakerNestedSandbox.description: Set sandbox.enableWeakerNestedSandbox to true. Needed in unprivileged containers, where bubblewrap cannot mount a fresh /proc. Reduces sandbox strength, so only enable it when the container itself is the isolation boundary you rely on.

gitHubCliTokenMasking.description: Mask GH_TOKEN in the sandbox instead of denying it. Sandboxed commands see a placeholder, and the sandbox proxy injects the real token only into requests to api.github.com. Also allows api.github.com and enables TLS termination in the sandbox network proxy, which the injection requires. For `gh run view --log`, also allows results-receiver.actions.githubusercontent.com, where api.github.com redirects log downloads, and allows sandbox writes to gh's cache directory, ~/.cache/gh (also readable) or /.jbdevcontainer/gh in JetBrains dev containers, where gh stores downloaded logs.
